Class ShellSort<T extends Comparable<T>>

java.lang.Object
assignments.datastructures.Vector<T>
assignments.sorting.ShellSort<T>
All Implemented Interfaces:
adt.List<T>, adt.Stack<T>, Iterable<T>
public class ShellSort<T extends Comparable<T>> extends Vector<T>
Implements ShellSort using the Hibbard incrementation sequence. Sorts a list by comparing and swapping elements that are distant from each other then decreases the distance between compared elements and repeats finishes by comparing adjacent elements resulting in a sorted array
